_comment: Copy this file to Tools\tool.config.json and fill in your own paths. The copy is git-ignored, so your paths stay on your machine. Paths support %ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE% and ~. Use forward or backslashes; the tool normalizes them.
_comment_addon: Root of the ADD-ON: the folder that contains addon.gproj. Detected automatically when the repository layout is standard, so you normally do not need to set it.
_comment_prefabs: REQUIRED. Root of the PodvalTvTPrefabs add-on (a separate repository, normally cloned as a sibling of this one). Without it the tool cannot check references or restore missions; suggestions still work from the bundled catalog.
_comment_source: Folder with the legacy (DRG-era) missions. Optional; used as the default in the mission search field.
_comment_dest: Default destination folder for restored missions. Defaults to <AddonRoot>\Worlds when left empty.
_comment_remap: Replacement table. Defaults to Tools\remap_table.json when left empty.
_comment_ai: AI assist is optional and OFF unless the environment variable below is set. The key itself is never written to this file - only the NAME of the environment variable that holds it.
